content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-97 establishes that CPT 93271 was bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable, and there is no current denial supporting another appeal or peer-to-peer request. The deductible does not make a contractual bundled denial patient-responsibility, so billing the patient would be improper; with no valid payer rework remaining, the balance should be adjusted off.","action":"write_off"}
